title: 3 easy ways to improve your outputs fast #ai #chatgpt #aitips
description:
3 reasons your ChatGPT and Claude outputs still suck:

1) They don’t know you.
2) You don’t have a brand style guide.
3) Your expectations are too high.

Try this: have a real conversation, then reverse engineer the prompt for better results. Follow for more daily AI tips.
